messages:
devon: Quick a11y catch from the console QA: breadcrumb trail in the model editor loses visible focus when you Tab through after opening the keyboard shortcuts modal. On VoiceOver the focus ring disappears and SR says \"Dialog\" instead of announcing crumb label. Repro: open model editor > press Cmd+/ > Tab to breadcrumbs.
maya: hmm that sounds like focus is being stolen by the modal backdrop. Is the backdrop getting `tabindex=0`? We recently added that for escape handling.
kevin: console log when I repro shows: 
```
modal: open
backdrop: focus received
focus: moving to breadcrumb[2]
focus-visible: no element matches
```
so backdrop is getting the focus first.
maya: backdrop shouldn't be tabbable. We intended to capture keydown globally. Suggest backdrop tabindex=-1 and listen for Esc on document.
devon: also noticed the breadcrumb links are `a` elements styled as chips with only outline on :focus not :focus-visible. Keyboard users who use mouse+keyboard lose the ring due to :focus-visible polyfill quirks.
kevin: agree. Our design tokens have `focus-ring-width: 1px` for compact chips. Let's increase it to `2px` for all crumb chips and use `var(--focus-accent)` that adapts to dark/light.
maya: another thing: screen reader reads the crumb twice for some items: once as link text and once because we have `aria-current=\"page\"` plus `aria-label` on the same node. We should avoid both. Use visible text + `aria-current` only.
a11y-bot: Automated checks: focusable-backdrop=1; duplicate-aria-announce=1; focus-visible-missing=1; contrast-warnings=0
devon: plan: (1) set backdrop tabindex to -1 and handle Esc at document; (2) bump crumb focus ring to 2px and ensure :focus-visible uses the token; (3) remove redundant aria-labels on crumbs and keep aria-current only when appropriate; (4) add a small integration test that opens modal and tabs through breadcrumb to assert focus stays visible.
kevin: I'll do (1) and the test. Small PR.
maya: I'll update tokens and snapshots for the crumb focus styles and adjust dark theme variable so ring contrasts at 3:1.
devon: I'll sweep codebase for other backdrops and ensure none are tabbable. Also attach the VoiceOver snippet to RT-6210.
a11y-bot: RT-6210 created. Priority: low-med. Regression-tests-needed=1
kevin: can someone run NVDA check? I only did mac VoiceOver.
maya: I can run NVDA tomorrow quick.
devon: aiming for PRs by EOD Friday, but I'll accept review earlier if someone picks it up. Thanks :thumbsup:
